es.literal: to throw firewood on the fire
es.meaning: To make a tense situation worse.
es.example: No le eches más leña al fuego, que ya están bastante enfadados.
es.exampleTranslation: Don't add more fuel to the fire, they're already angry enough.

it.literal: to throw gasoline on the fire
it.meaning: To inflame an already tense situation.
it.example: Dire questo ora significa gettare benzina sul fuoco.
it.exampleTranslation: Saying that now means pouring fuel on the fire.

bridge.note: Same image, escalating fuel: Spanish adds wood, Italian adds gasoline. Worth noticing the verb: gettare is Italian's all-purpose throw, and it turns up wherever something is flung down or given up.

interference.es_to_it: 'Gettare legna sul fuoco' reads as literally adding firewood. The Italian idiom pours fuel on it: benzina.
interference.it_to_es: 'Echar gasolina al fuego' is understood but isn't the fixed form. Spanish adds wood: echar leña al fuego.
